properties.statement:
FIELD EVIDENCE FROM A SECOND PROJECT ON THE SAME MACHINE, 2026-08-31. `proj:bhome` — a brand-new empty repo bootstrapped from a paragraph brief about a transportable pod dwelling — kept a running `feedback.md` across four session parts and filed it for review.

⭐ IT RAN 0.45.0, THE CURRENT BINARY — checked off `.reflow2/graph.server.json` before reading a word of the report, because a version-stale report is the failure mode this project has now hit three times. These findings are LIVE.

═══ ① THE SILENT MALFORMED WRITE — TWO MORE INSTANCES, AND THEY ANSWER TWO OPEN CAVEATS ═══
The agent put literal `</decision><parameter name="rationale">` markup inside a prose string on `add_decision`, and the identical shape on `add_change_event` (`</summary><parameter name="rationale">`). BOTH ACCEPTED SILENTLY, both returning a normal success payload.

`fact:tool-call-markup-bleeds-into-the-last-prose-field-and-typed-fields-catch-it` (2026-08-30) already holds the cause and it is unchanged: a free-prose property bag has no shape to fail against, a required typed field does — 3 of 3 prose fields stored the garbage, 2 of 2 required enums refused loudly. bhome does not overturn any of it. WHAT IT SETTLES IS TWO OF THAT NODE'S FOUR "NOT ESTABLISHED" ITEMS:
· "Whether five in one session is a rate or an outlier. One session, one agent, one model." → NOW SEVEN ACROSS TWO PROJECTS, TWO SESSIONS, TWO GRAPHS. Still not a rate, but no longer a single-session artifact.
· "Whether the same bleed reaches OTHER free-text fields — `statement`, `decision`, `description`, `findings`. Only `rationale` and `summary` were observed." → `decision` IS NOW CONFIRMED.

🛑 AND bhome ADDS A CONSEQUENCE NEITHER NODE RECORDS: THE BLEED SWALLOWS SUBSEQUENT STRUCTURED PARAMETERS, NOT ONLY PROSE. On the `add_decision` instance the node landed with the markup in `decision`, NO `rationale` at all, AND NONE OF THE THREE `related_to` RELATIONS DRAWN. The reporter's own words: a node whose rationale is missing "reads as a node somebody chose not to justify, and no detector can tell those apart" — and `unreviewed_ideas` could not fire either, because the relations were lost in the same stroke so the node genuinely had none. The damage is silent in three ways at once.

═══ ② THE CROSS-TYPE DUPLICATE REFUSAL — FOUR OCCURRENCES, AND THIS IS THE MEASUREMENT THAT WAS OWED ═══
`fact:the-near-match-filter-has-no-node-type-term` (2026-08-29) located the cause exactly: the filter at capture.rs:190 has two terms, not-itself and score-above-floor, and NEITHER is the node type. Repair ② (name the layering in the message) shipped; repair ① (exclude the prescribed layer pairs) was deliberately NOT built, and that node says why: "THE MEASUREMENT THAT WOULD JUSTIFY THE OTHER REPAIR STILL HAS NOT BEEN TAKEN: nobody has counted how often a cross-type hit is a REAL duplicate rather than the prescribed layered capture."

⇒ bhome COUNTED IT, WITHOUT BEING ASKED TO: FOUR cross-type refusals in one session, and ALL FOUR WERE FALSE ALARMS of one shape — a Requirement and the Capability created moments later to satisfy it (`cap:satellite-link` vs `req:satellite-comms-optional`; `cap:manage-salt` vs `req:salt-does-not-accumulate`; `cap:cycle-air-to-the-beds` vs `req:air-loop`; and the Latimer Decision vs `req:self-sustaining`).

⭐⭐ AND THE REPORTER'S FRAMING IS SHARPER THAN THE ORIGINAL FINDING'S: "the guard is firing hardest on the most canonical pattern reflow2 has." During GENESIS every capability is created moments after the requirement it satisfies, so the golden thread — the thing reflow2 teaches — is precisely what trips the guard.

🛑 A FIFTH OCCURRENCE, DIFFERENT SHAPE, AND IT IS WORSE: the guard REFUSED THE BRAINSTORM SKILL'S OWN RULE. That skill says "several unrelated ideas mean several Decisions; one node holding two unrelated questions can never be answered, only half-answered." The agent obeyed it and the guard then refused the second Decision as too close to the first. A guard re-litigating an instruction the same product issued is a different defect from a false positive.

═══ ⚠️ BOUNDS ═══
· ONE PROJECT, ONE SESSION, ONE AGENT, and the agent is an LLM session rather than an independent user — the same caveat the 08-30 markup finding carries.
· 4 of 4 false alarms is a small denominator. It does not establish the cross-type FALSE-POSITIVE RATE; it establishes that the canonical genesis pattern reliably produces them, which is a narrower and more actionable claim.
· The report is self-assessed. Two of the items it lists as friction it also labels "mine not reflow2's", and that self-classification has not been independently checked.
